question: Does the KVM global-state RPC path invoke serde serialize/deserialize at runtime, or is it a direct in-address-space call (like ptrace release)?
verdict: PROPERTY HOLDS — KVM global-state RPC is a direct in-process async call; no runtime serde in release or debug. Not a KVM perf bug.
rpc_path_files_vs_main: reverie-kvm/src/runtime.rs, reverie-kvm/Cargo.toml, reverie-ptrace/src/task.rs are byte-identical to origin/main; finding is a property of main (checkout branch only adds an executor unit test elsewhere)

evidence.source_kvm_send_rpc: reverie-kvm/src/runtime.rs:333-336 (KvmGlobal) and :405-414 (KvmGuest) both call receive_rpc(tid, message) directly; message passed by value; global_state is &T::GlobalState / Arc<T::GlobalState> (same address space)
evidence.source_ptrace_debug_only: reverie-ptrace/src/task.rs:5507 WrappedFrom::send_rpc round-trips through bincode ONLY under cfg!(debug_assertions); release passes args directly
evidence.dep_graph: reverie-kvm/Cargo.toml has no reverie-rpc-transport dep; cargo tree -p reverie-kvm -i bincode shows bincode reaches kvm only via reverie-process (container bootstrap), not RPC
evidence.call_site_census: grep -rn bincode::serde reverie*/src/ — RPC serialize sites are in reverie-rpc-transport/codec.rs, reverie-dbi/sync_rpc.rs, reverie-preload/rpc.rs, reverie-ptrace debug round-trip, gdbstub, container bootstrap; ZERO in reverie-kvm
evidence.runtime_test: cargo test -p reverie-kvm --test counter => 3 passed in 0.06s incl hierarchical_counter_aggregates_per_process (cross-process global RPC via receive_rpc on real /dev/kvm guest)
evidence.link_artifact: nm target/debug/deps/counter-<hash>: reverie_rpc_transport symbol count = 0; KvmGlobal/KvmGuest send_rpc symbols present + monomorphized

adjacent_findings: reverie-dbi (sync_rpc.rs) and reverie-preload/liteinst (rpc.rs) DO serialize RPC at runtime in all builds (genuinely out-of-process); possible overhead contributor there, NOT KVM

reverie/CLAUDE.md architecture table is stale: claims KVM runs GlobalState in a coordinator process over reverie-rpc-transport (UDS+bincode); actual code runs it in-process via direct call — recommend doc correction
assurance_level: code-trace + dependency-graph + call-site census + runtime backend-test (real KVM guest) + link-level symbol check
